call_points.text: FY27 guidance held at 15% organic revenue growth, 1.5-2% inorganic and 20% PAT growth.
Q1 revenue growth of 21.9% beat the stated 15% guidance, but management said not to annualise a single quarter.
EBITDA margin rose about 190 bps to 22% on favourable product mix and operating leverage.
India business grew 22.7% YoY and was 97% of revenue; international did not grow this quarter.
Chronic and semi-chronic therapies were 73.4% of the portfolio in Q1FY27.
Depreciation rose to ₹13.4 Cr from ₹10 Cr a year ago, mainly on Wokadine and Bayer brand amortisation.
In-house manufacturing is about 60% and outsourcing 40%, expected to stay at that split in FY27.
Q4FY26 EBITDA margin dropped to 17.6% due to new division investments and higher R&D spends.
Chronic and semi-chronic therapies contributed 71.9% of overall revenue in FY26.
FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 80 bps to 20.9%, but Q4 margin fell 80 bps to 17.6%.
Bhayla facility received EAEU-GMP certification in January 2026, opening five Eurasian markets.
Capacity expansion at Bhayla adds 400 Mn tablets and capsules to installed capacity.
Chronic and sub-chronic therapies were 72.3% of Q4FY26 revenue and 71.9% of FY26.
Portfolio mix shifted from 70:30 to 28:72 acute:chronic between FY13 and FY26.

guidance.statement: We expect to sustain 15% plus revenue growth organically and 25% revenue growth in acquired brand with 20% plus PAT growth in FY27 too.
Target 15% organic revenue growth for FY27
Target about 1.5% to 2% inorganic revenue growth for FY27
Target 25% growth for the Wokadine brand over three years, from ₹20 Cr to ₹40 Cr

Company held fixed deposits of ₹155.70 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
Exceptional charge of ₹19.10 Cr recognized in FY26 for statutory impact of new Labour Codes.

Top 10 brands account for 50.4% of revenue; 32 'Engine' brands contribute ~76% of domestic sales.
Total installed capacity is ~1.65 Bn units p.a. after adding 400 Mn tablets at Gujarat, commenced 22 December 2025.
Total medical representative strength reached 3,100 after adding 450 MRs in FY26.
Bhayla hormone facility received EU-GMP Compliance Certification and the Bhayla OSD facility had EU-GMP approval renewed after an April 2026 EUDRA GMP inspection.
In-house manufacturing is about 60% and outsourcing 40%, expected to stay at that split in FY27.
Corona holds a 31% stake in associate La Chandra Pharma Lab, which supplies about 60-65% of its hormonal API.
The company has 3,111 medical representatives and plans to add 200-250 a year, or 6-8%.
ANVISA GMP certification covers both OSD and Women's Hormone lines at Bhayla, Ahmedabad; India contributes over 96% of revenue.
Q2FY27 revenue grew 22.2% YoY to ₹441.17 Cr, outperforming the wider Indian Pharmaceutical Market.
Received ANVISA GMP certification for Bhayla OSD & Hormone Manufacturing Facility in October 2026.

timeline.summary: Corona Remedies reported FY26 revenue growth to ₹1,403 Cr and recommended a ₹10 final dividend.
CORONA Remedies Limited’s Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of ₹10 per equity share on May 11, 2026.
Corona Remedies' May 2026 investor presentation reported FY26 revenue of ₹1,403.2 Cr (+17.3%) and adjusted PAT of ₹199.4 Cr (+33.4%), with Q4 EBITDA margin at 17.6%.
CORONA Remedies Limited shared Q4 FY26 earnings call audio recording on its website on May 12, 2026, per Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Rules.
Corona Remedies hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on May 12, 2026, guiding for 15%+ organic revenue growth in FY27.
On April 1, 2026, promoter Nirav Mehta declared zero share encumbrance for FY2025-26 under SEBI Takeover Regulations.
Ankur Mehta, Joint Managing Director, declared no encumbrance on CORONA Remedies’ equity shares by promoters or Persons Acting in Concert for FY2025-26, filed April 1, 2026.

On 28 May 2026, CORONA Remedies said it received EU-GMP Compliance Certification for its Bhayla hormone facility and renewed EU-GMP approval for its Bhayla OSD facility after an April 2026 EUDRA GMP inspection.
CORONA Remedies’ **Prabhat Kumar Dharajiya** and **Chetna Dharajiya** to attend JM Financial 1x1 meetings on June 4–5, 2026, in Mumbai.
On 3 August 2026 Corona Remedies' Q1FY27 call reported revenue of ₹422 Cr (+21.9% YoY) and PAT of ₹60 Cr (+30.1%), with FY27 guidance held at 15% organic growth and 20% PAT growth.
On 22 October 2026 Corona Remedies received ANVISA GMP certification for its Bhayla, Ahmedabad OSD and Women's Hormone facilities, its third major GMP accreditation after EU-GMP and EAEU-GMP.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹441.17 Cr (+22.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹60.31 Cr (+15.3% YoY).
Corona Remedies reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹441.2 Cr (+22.2% YoY) and PAT of ₹60.3 Cr (+15.3% YoY).
